milestone: SeLinOS transferred child TCB single-resume M2

contract.child: Root configures and spawns one fresh child in the suspended state. Taskd receives its TCB cap and invokes exactly one seL4_TCB_Resume.
contract.completion: The child has only one completion-send cap and emits exactly (CHILD_RAN, slot=1, generation=1); taskd validates it before probe success.
contract.authority: No allocator, child CSpace/VSpace construction, register/stack/TLS setup, additional TCB control, device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority is delegated to taskd or objectd.

required_markers: SeLinOS TCB resume M2: fresh child spawned suspended for one taskd resume.
SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2: exact slot 1 request accepted.
SeLinOS objectd TCB resume M2: suspended child TCB cap transferred to taskd.
SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2: one transferred child TCB resumed.
SeLinOS TCB resume M2 child: one fixed completion sent.
SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2: exact one child completion validated.
SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2 probe: one transferred child resume passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2: malformed client request rejected.
SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2: TCB cap reply rejected.
SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2: one resume rejected.
SeLinOS taskd TCB resume M2: child completion rejected.

not_claimed: dynamic child creation, child configuration, stack/register/TLS setup, clone flags or client-selected task state
second resume, suspend, scheduler change, process exit, teardown, release, revocation or reuse
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading or dynamic linker semantics
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority
